about: Hard set of the voice-to-line benchmark for Line by Line (2026-11-06). Synthetic test input: notes written by us in a mechanic's voice to be harder than the base set (several jobs in one note, work already done or declined, price-list words that are not a job, shop slang, self-corrections, work the shop does not do next to work it does, urgency stated against the usual default), spoken by macOS text-to-speech with louder shop noise. Labeled by us and checked blind by two independent labelers. Not real customers, not real mechanics. Expected = the price-list codes a service writer would add, with urgency; [] = no billable line.

findings.note: Okay, so on this one, front pads are at two millimeters, the serpentine belt is cracked all over, and the cabin filter is full of leaves. Pads are a must today, the belt in the next few weeks, the filter whenever.
Battery failed the load test, the front wiper blades are chattering, and the engine air filter is black. Battery soon, the rest is just a recommendation.

Brake fluid tested at five percent water, the coolant is rusty, the trans fluid smells burnt, and it's a thousand miles past the oil change. Do all the fluids in the next couple of weeks, nothing is an emergency.
Right front wheel bearing is growling and it has play, the left outer tie rod is loose too, and once those are in it needs an alignment. It's not safe to drive like this.
Driver headlight is out, the third brake light is out, and the wipers are smearing. The lights first, those are a safety issue, the wipers can wait.
Front struts are leaking and the sway bar end links are clunking, both sides. Struts and links soon. And rotate the tires while it's up, no rush on that.
Thermostat is stuck open, the water pump is weeping, and the coolant is overdue. Do the pump and the thermostat soon, and flush the coolant while we're in there.
All four corners. Front pads and rotors are metal on metal. Rear pads are at four millimeters, rear rotors are fine. Fronts today, the rear pads in the next month or so.
Customer says we did the front brakes here last month, and they look good. The only thing is the rear pads, they're down to two millimeters, that has to be done before she leaves.
Battery was replaced at another shop two weeks ago and it tests good. The cabin filter is dirty though, just recommend it.
She declined the alignment last time and she declined it again today, so don't put it on. The tires are wearing evenly anyway. Just the oil change, she's a thousand miles over.
We already rotated the tires and topped off the washer fluid, that's done. Nothing else needed today.
No leaks at the water pump, the thermostat opens fine, the coolant is clean. Cooling system checks out. The only thing I found is a torn engine mount on the passenger side, do that soon.
The serpentine belt was replaced at sixty thousand and it still looks new. The noise is the tensioner, the bearing is dry and squealing. Do the tensioner soon.
Don't touch the spark plugs, the owner did them last weekend. The check engine light came on after that though, it's a misfire code, it needs a diagnosis.
Customer asked how much a new battery would be. I told her hers is fine, it tested at full strength. Tire pressures were low, I set them. Nothing to add.
The clip on the air filter box was broken, we zip tied it, no charge. The filter itself is fine.

When the alignment rack frees up, can someone move this car out? Anyway, the CV boots are fine, but the left front tire has a nail right in the sidewall. It can't be plugged, it needs a new tire, she shouldn't drive on it like that.

The last owner put a cheap battery and cheap wipers in it, both still working fine, I'd just keep an eye on them. Today it needs the front rotors, they're warped, it pulses at every stop. Do them in the next couple of weeks.
The A C works great, blowing ice cold, the customer was worried about it for nothing. Brakes are fine, belts are fine. Just an oil change, it's due.
Tie rods, ball joints, bearings, all tight. The front end is solid. I'd just recommend the transmission fluid, it's the original fluid at ninety thousand.
I checked the thermostat housing for leaks because of the smell, it's dry. The smell is the valve cover gasket dripping oil on the exhaust. It needs doing soon.
Pads up front are toast, down to the backing plate, and the rotors are grooved bad. Don't let it leave.
Dog bone mount is shot, and the half shaft is clicking on hard turns, the boot is ripped wide open. Both soon.
Got a P zero one seven one lean code and the mass air flow sensor is caked. The customer wants the light looked at.
Stabilizer links are knocking and the front struts are blown, it porpoises over every dip. Get them both done soon.
C C A is at half the rating and the posts are crusty. She won't crank on a cold morning. Swap it soon.
Freon is low, the compressor kicks on and off every few seconds. No leak on the sniffer. Top it off whenever she wants.
Front left hub has play, it wobbles side to side and hums at forty. That's a do not drive.
Uh, front pads, no wait, the rear pads, sorry, the rears are at two millimeters. The fronts are fine.
Needs a new battery. Actually scratch that, it was just a loose terminal, I tightened it and it's fine now. The wipers though, they're streaking, recommend them.
Um, the engine air filter, I mean the cabin filter, the one behind the glove box, is clogged. The engine filter is okay. No hurry.
Plugs are due, it's a four cylinder at, um, like a hundred and twenty thousand. And, uh, coolant, no, the coolant is fine, it's the brake fluid that's dark. Both soon.
Left rear tire has a screw, uh, in the shoulder, hold on, no, it's in the tread, okay, we can plug it. Do it soon, it's slowly losing air.
Thermostat, er, sorry, water pump. The water pump is leaking from the weep hole. The thermostat is fine. Soon.
The exhaust flex pipe has a hole, it sounds like a race car, and the rear brake rotors are rusted with a big lip. We don't do exhaust here, send that out. Rotors soon.
The sunroof rattles and the driver window is slow, we don't do either of those. The headlight on the passenger side is out though.
The timing belt is due at a hundred and five thousand, that's a dealer job, we don't do it. The serpentine is fine. The power steering hose is seeping, also not ours. Nothing for us today.
The windshield has a crack across the driver's view, recommend glass replacement, that's not us. And the front wiper blades are torn, replace those soon.
The catalytic converter is rattling, that's a muffler shop job. Also the check engine light is on, P zero four two zero again, and the customer wants it diagnosed here first.
Rear shocks are leaking, we don't stock those. The front struts are dry and fine. Rear brake pads are at three millimeters, do them in the next few weeks.
The brake light on the left is out. The customer is driving to another state tonight, it has to be done before she leaves.
The tie rod end has a tiny bit of play, it's within spec for now. Recommend replacing it at the next visit, and an alignment then.
The front right tire has about three thirty-seconds of tread left. It's legal, but it'll be bald by winter. Replace it in the next month.
The battery is weak, but it started fine all week. No rush, it can wait till spring.
Brake fluid is dark, but the pedal is firm. Just a recommendation.
The drive belt is shredding, pieces are coming off it. If it goes she loses the power steering and the water pump on the highway. Do not let it leave.
The cabin filter and the engine air filter are both dirty, and the A C is low on refrigerant. None of it is urgent, all recommendations.
